Name: Stardrop Casino
Author: soda5cm
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardrop Casino[/b][/size]

Gus has been hiding something under the Stardrop Saloon. Climb down the trapdoor in the barrel storeroom and you'll find a full casino, styled after the Oasis club: [b]nine games, all played for gold[/b].

[b]Available in English and Russian.[/b]

[size=4][b]Getting there[/b][/size]
Walk through the saloon's arcade room into the barrel storeroom at the back. There's an open trapdoor in the floor. Interact with it to go down. The casino is open [b]12:00 – 24:00[/b] (configurable). The exit at the bottom of the hall takes you back up.

[size=4][b]Games[/b][/size]
Game — How it plays
[b]Blackjack[/b] — 6-deck shoe, dealer stands on 17, blackjack pays 3:2, double and split. Cards are dealt from the shoe and flip over.
[b]Texas Hold'em[/b] — No-limit poker against three villagers (Pam, Clint, Shane, Abigail, Sebastian, Emily, Harvey, Gus, Sam, Willy, Lewis, Marnie, Pierre, Robin, Leah, Elliott). Each has their own style: some play tight, some love to bluff, and they talk at the table. Three tables with different blinds. Side pots work. Playing gives a little friendship (once a day).
[b]Slots[/b] — Three reels of Stardew produce. Three Stardrops pay x150.
[b]Roulette[/b] — European single-zero wheel. Straight numbers, red/black, odd/even, low/high, dozens and columns. Click to place chips, right-click to take them back.
[b]Chicken Races[/b] — Five chickens with odds based on their form of the day. Pick one and watch them run.
[b]Dice[/b] — Under 7, exactly 7, or over 7.
[b]High-Low[/b] — Guess if the next card is higher or lower. Every right guess multiplies the pot. Cash out whenever you like.
[b]Wheel of Fortune[/b] — One free spin every day, then paid spins. Prizes include gold, bars, seeds, a Diamond and a rare Prismatic Shard.
[b]Lotto[/b] — Pick 6 numbers out of 36 (or quick-pick). The draw is at midnight and the results come by mail in the morning.

The bear computer shows your casino record: total wagered, paid out, net result and biggest win.

[size=4][b]Fair odds[/b][/size]
The house edge is real but reasonable, and the math is unit-tested: roulette returns 36/37, slots about 94%, lotto about 87%, chicken race odds are set from 8,000 simulated races. You can set a [b]daily loss limit[/b] in the config.

[size=4][b]Config ([font=Courier New]config.json[/font] or Generic Mod Config Menu)[/b][/size]
Option — Default — What it does
[font=Courier New]MinBet[/font] / [font=Courier New]MaxBet[/font] — 10 / 5000 — Bet limits for all games
[font=Courier New]DailyLossLimit[/font] — 0 — Stop taking bets after losing this much in a day (0 = no limit)
[font=Courier New]OpenTime[/font] / [font=Courier New]CloseTime[/font] — 1200 / 2400 — Casino hours
[font=Courier New]LottoTicketPrice[/font] — 100 — Price of one lotto ticket
[font=Courier New]LottoTicketsPerDay[/font] — 5 — Max tickets per day
[font=Courier New]WheelSpinPrice[/font] — 250 — Price of a paid wheel spin
[font=Courier New]FreeDailyWheelSpin[/font] — true — One free spin per day

Console command: [font=Courier New]casino[/font] takes you straight inside.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
The casino is a new location. The only change to an existing map is the trapdoor tiles in the saloon storeroom (Maps/Saloon, tiles 33–34, 7–8). Mods that rebuild that room may hide the entrance; the [font=Courier New]casino[/font] command always works.

All gambling here is with in-game gold only.
